raw.english_explanation: This is an attendance warning from Cedar Heights High School. The school says Jordan has missed 9 days this semester, including 4 unexcused absences. They want the parent or guardian to contact the Attendance Office soon to set up a meeting to review the absences and discuss support. The notice also says to send a note for any absence caused by a medical or family reason so it can be excused.
raw.spanish: Esta es una notificación de advertencia sobre la asistencia de Cedar Heights High School. La escuela dice que Jordan ha faltado 9 días este semestre, incluidas 4 ausencias injustificadas. Quieren que el padre, madre o tutor se comunique con la Oficina de Asistencia lo antes posible para programar una reunión y revisar las ausencias y hablar sobre apoyo. El aviso también dice que se envíe una nota por cualquier ausencia por motivo médico o familiar para que pueda justificarse.
raw.tagalog: Ito ay isang abiso ng babala tungkol sa pagdalo mula sa Cedar Heights High School. Sinasabi ng paaralan na si Jordan ay lumiban nang 9 na araw ngayong semestre, kabilang ang 4 na hindi may-katwirang pagliban. Hinihiling nila na makipag-ugnayan ang magulang o tagapag-alaga sa Attendance Office sa lalong madaling panahon upang mag-iskedyul ng pulong para repasuhin ang mga pagliban at pag-usapan ang posibleng tulong. Sinasabi rin ng abiso na magpadala ng sulat para sa anumang pagliban na may medikal o pampamilyang dahilan upang ito ay maipawalang-sala.

CEDAR HEIGHTS HIGH SCHOOL

Office of Student Auendance
1200 Heights Boulevard, Cedar Heights, NJ 07992

October 20, 2026
To the parent or guardian of Jordan P. (Grade 10)
Re: Attendance concern

Our records show that Jordan has been absent for 9 days this semester, including 4 unexcused
absences. School policy asks us to meet with families when absences reach this level so that
we can understand what support may help.

Please contact the Attendance Office as soon as possible to schedule a meeting.

At the meeting we can review the absence record, discuss any barriers to attending, and agree
ona plan. Parent-teacher conferences will also take place during the week of November 16-
20, 2026; attendance may be discussed there as well.

Please send a note to the school for any absence that has a medical or family reason so that it
can be excused.

Attendance Office, (973) 555-0184, attendance@cedarheights-hs.example.

Sincerely,
Ms. I.. Okonkwo-Reyes
Attendance Coordinator
